metadata.summary: Ryan Gravenberch's sending off in Liverpool's 3-0 home defeat to Manchester City was a "shocking decision" by referee Chris Kavanagh, according to Sky Sports pundit Jamie Carragher.
metadata.content: Liverpool 0-3 Man City: Ryan Gravenberch's sending off in Premier League defeat criticised by Jamie Carragher | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Liverpool 0-3 Man City: Ryan Gravenberch's sending off in Premier League defeat criticised by Jamie Carragher Man City eased to a 3-0 win at 10-man Liverpool after Ryan Gravenberch was sent off for a second bookable offence – but it was his first yellow that frustrated Jamie Carragher, who said referee Chris Kavanagh only cautioned the midfielder when he thought Elliot Anderson was hurt Jamie Carragher Football Expert and Columnist Sunday 11 October 2026 19:57, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Watch the incident as Liverpool's Ryan Gravenberch is sent off for a second yellow card against Manchester City. Ryan Gravenberch's sending off in Liverpool's 3-0 home defeat to Manchester City was a "shocking decision" by referee Chris Kavanagh, according to Sky Sports pundit Jamie Carragher. Gravenberch, the standout player for an hour, was shown red after receiving a second yellow for a challenge on Jeremy Doku with the game tied at 0-0 in a flashpoint that turned the game, which had been finely poised, in City's favour. Erling Haaland's opener came just two minutes and 37 seconds after Gravenberch was dismissed, and within six minutes Doku had doubled City's advantage before Rayan Cherki added a third with 12 minutes to play. messages.text: Greaves ends Women's Series season with record-breaking win

metadata.summary: Beau Greaves ended her 2026 PDC Women's Series season with a record-breaking streak of victories on the way to two tournament wins at Event 23 and 24 in Wigan.
metadata.content: PDC Women's Series: Beau Greaves ends season with highest event-winning average in tournament history | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content PDC Women's Series: Beau Greaves ends season with highest event-winning average in tournament history Beau Greaves records the highest event-winning average in Women's Series history; Vicky Pruim secures World Darts Championship qualification; you can watch the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton live on Sky Sports from November 14-22 Sunday 11 October 2026 22:41, UK Image: Greaves recorded an average of 98.75 across her seven matches Beau Greaves ended her 2026 PDC Women's Series season with a record-breaking streak of victories on the way to two tournament wins at Event 23 and 24 in Wigan. Greaves - who had already claimed back-to-back titles in Event 21 and 22 on Saturday - averaged 98.75 on the way to her third successive competition title at Event 23, marking the highest event-winning average in the history of the Women's Series. The Yorkshire native - who has won 17 out of a possible 24 Women's Series events this year - won all of her first four matches by a 4-0 scoreline, posting a stunning 103.66 average in her victory against Steph Clark. messages.text: Miracle in London as Jaguars beat Eagles with field goal as time expires

metadata.summary: Cam Little kicked a 57-yard field goal as time expired to give the Jacksonville Jaguars a 19-17 win over the Philadelphia Eagles in a miraculous ending at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.

Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence threw a 27-yard touchdown to Parker Washington on fourth down with under four minutes remaining to give them a 16-14 lead, and when they forced the Eagles to punt with two minutes left, the win looked all but secure.
